techDocsSubtitle: Architecture and technical specifications of the ecosystem.
techSec1Desc: The solution relies on an ecosystem of Dockerized microservices orchestrating the analytic data lifecycle.
techFlaskDesc: Provides asynchronous RESTful endpoints and serves the frontend interface built with Tailwind CSS and Vanilla JS.
techPgDesc: Central persistent engine configured with transactional schemas for raw data and relational tables optimized for analytics.
techDagsterWebDesc: Exposes the graphical control panel of Dagster, allowing data lineage tracing and real-time monitoring of run statuses.
techDagsterDaemonDesc: Background execution coordinator managing queue persistence, retries, and schedulers.
techSec2Desc: Asynchronous business logic is encapsulated in Dagster Software-Defined Assets (SDAs) (etl/definitions.py). This orchestrator coordinates data collection and batch inference engines.
techSec2Body: The pipeline begins by extracting unprocessed metadata, grouped and parallelized into computational inference nodes (LLM). If an unrecoverable failure occurs in a batch, the system drops the records into a local Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) for manual inspection, allowing the main DAG pipeline to continue uninterrupted.
techSec3Desc: The data warehouse implements an OLAP Star Schema designed to maximize analytical read throughput on the frontend.
techFactTableDesc: Fact table containing atomic per-article granularity (word count, sentiment score).
techSec3Body: Ingestion uses idempotent logic via UPSERT operations (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE or DO NOTHING), ensuring that ETL re-executions do not generate duplicates or primary key violations.
techSec4Desc: Semantic inference is built on a fault-tolerant hybrid pipeline leveraging Groq and Gemini (Flash) SDKs.
techSec4Body: The system applies strict Prompt Engineering to enforce valid JSON outputs. Pydantic schemas enforce the expected data contract. Specific instructions force the model to normalize linguistic variations and slang (such as "Edomex") into standardized entities ("Estado de México"), ensuring accurate relational joins during geographic mapping.
techSec5Desc: The engine integrates an advanced analytical assistant capable of querying the underlying relational model.
techSseDesc: Implemented via native Server-Sent Events (SSE) in Flask for progressive, asynchronous streaming responses on the frontend, avoiding HTTP timeouts.
techContextDesc: The LLM dynamically receives a serialized dump of metrics and access to historical runs to answer using Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
techSec6Desc: The system exposes modular configurations allowing horizontal scaling of the platform without modifying core code.
techGeoCacheDesc: Territorial topologies are preloaded (geojson_cache.py) from map_config.json and static vector files, dramatically reducing I/O overhead during Leaflet rendering.
techI18nDesc: The frontend abstracts an injected dictionary that toggles data-i18n keys via client-side JavaScript iterators.

userManualSubtitle: Operation guide for the AI News Explorer platform.
userSec1Desc: AI News Explorer is a news intelligence and monitoring platform. It allows you to search for any topic of interest, collect the latest related news, and obtain an intelligent, visual analysis of tone (sentiment), geographical distribution, and key concepts discussed across articles.
userSec2Desc: The first step is using the top search bar. Type a query (e.g., "Elections" or "Artificial Intelligence") and click the filter icon to configure advanced parameters:
userFilterSecWordsDesc: Forces results to include specific required terms.
userFilterExcludeDesc: Useful to clean noise (e.g., if searching for "Apple", exclude "fruit").
userFilterDateDesc: Limits how far back to search for articles.
userFilterCountryDesc: Sets the maximum results limit and the country region that guides the map.
userWaitNoteDesc: Data extraction is a deep asynchronous process. Queries with large quantities of news (e.g., 50 results) require time to fetch, read, and interpret each text.
userSec3Desc: Once extraction finishes, the "Analytics & Maps" tab presents the intelligent summary of the dataset.
userKpisDesc: Top cards showing total evaluated articles, how many were successfully mapped to a region, and the Average Sentiment (shifting towards green for positive news, and red for negative).
userPieDesc: Visualizes which newspapers or portals published the highest volume of articles on the topic.
userTimelineDesc: Line chart showing publication frequency peaks across collected news.
userSec4Desc: The map tool colors states of a country (such as Mexico or USA) based on the volume of news mentioning that specific region.
userMapFilterDesc: Clicking a highlighted state immediately filters the news table on the right to show only what occurred in that specific area.
userMapExtractBtnDesc: The core feature of the platform. Once you have base news, click this top button to have AI read content, identify cities/states, and activate the heatmap.
userSec5Desc: The collapsible right panel houses a conversational assistant capable of reading your entire active dataset.
userChatbotBody: You can ask natural questions like: "Summarize negative news related to Mexico City" or "List the top 5 most mentioned persons across the reports". The chatbot understands full context and returns structured lists or tables.
userSec6Desc: The platform remembers your past queries.
userHistoryTabDesc: Acts as an archive. If you ran a large search yesterday, you can click it here to instantly reload all charts and maps without re-running extraction.
userJobsTabDesc: Displays a real-time monitor of background operations. You will see when a task is "Running" or "Completed".
userExportDesc: The top-right export button compiles all metrics, detected entities, and article links into an Excel spreadsheet for easy integration with tools like PowerBI.
userLangDesc: The Settings gear icon provides a quick toggle to instantly switch all menus, labels, and documentation between Spanish and English.
techSec2DescScraper: The system features a highly concurrent, anti-bot resilient web extraction layer responsible for gathering full articles and metadata.
techScraperEvasionDesc: Leverages curl_cffi to impersonate TLS browser fingerprints and bypass automated bot-detection. For complex SPAs requiring JS execution, headless Playwright sessions are orchestrated.
techScraperParseDesc: Primary content extraction relies on Trafilatura to extract meaningful article body while stripping ads and footers. BeautifulSoup serves as fallback parser and metadata extractor (e.g. og:image).
techScraperConcurrencyDesc: Network I/O is accelerated via ThreadPoolExecutor workers alongside asynchronous coroutines, enabling parallel multi-URL scraping without blocking Flask's event loop.
techScraperRSSDesc: The initial discovery phase leverages Google News RSS feeds to fetch structured metadata, direct URLs, and apply base deduplication before proceeding to the deep full-text scraping of the original article.
